description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real household survey data with two variables: 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure in dollars) and 'income' (weekly income in $100 units) for 40 households.

Export the entire dataset to a CSV (comma-separated values) file. Use the menu: File > Save data as. In the save dialog, navigate to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/, set the filename to 'food_data', and select CSV format from the file type dropdown (it may be labeled 'CSV data' or 'Comma-separated values'). Click Save to export the data. The result should be a file at /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/food_data.csv containing all 40 observations.

metadata.data_source: Hill, Griffiths, Lim - Principles of Econometrics 5th ed, household survey data
